_comment: Hand-maintained mapping from OVH's AI Endpoints catalog to pricing.json entries.
Nothing here is inferred at runtime: no fuzzy matching, no lowercasing and hoping.
'catalog_id' is compared byte-for-byte against the 'id' field of a catalog entry
in the page's embedded model data, 'catalog_name' against that entry's 'name', and
each field's 'price_unit' byte-for-byte against that entry's
metadata.usage_information.pricing[].price_unit. A catalog that no longer contains
a matching id, a matching name, or a pricing entry with that exact unit, is a
failure to report, never a row to guess at.
The keys of 'models' are API model ids, and they come from the catalog's 'name'
field -- NOT from its 'id'. The two are different things and it matters: the entry
whose id is 'qwen-3-6-27b' is called as 'Qwen3.6-27B', and 'llama-3-3-70b-instruct'
is called as 'Meta-Llama-3_3-70B-Instruct'. 'id' is a CMS slug for the catalog's own
URLs. Fifteen of the nineteen names below were confirmed against OVH's public
OpenAI-compatible model list (https://oai.endpoints.kepler.ai.cloud.ovh.net/v1/models,
no key required) on 2026-08-04; the four nvr-tts entries are absent from that list
because text-to-speech is served from its own per-model endpoint rather than the
OpenAI-compatible one, and keep the name the catalog gives them.
Three things deliberately NOT in this file, checked against the catalog on
2026-08-04 by a human, all revisit-worthy:
Withdrawn from the catalog page, but still sold: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct,
Qwen3-32B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3,
Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407. A browser copy of the page cached on 2026-08-03
showed all five, under the header '24 resultats disponibles'. Every fetch since
-- eight locales, cache-busted, both 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-04 -- returns '19
resultats disponibles' and does not contain the substring 'mistral' anywhere in
the HTML. So OVH dropped them from the catalog page between those two dates.
They are NOT retired from the service: the OpenAI-compatible model list above
still returns all five with live non-zero prices. That list is not used as a
price source here because it quotes USD, not the EUR this block publishes, and
its figures are genuinely different numbers -- not the same prices in another
format. Add these five if and when the catalog page lists them again; do not
backfill them from the API, and do not convert.
Priced in a unit this file has no key for: none at present. Every unit the
catalog currently uses is mapped below.
Nothing else. Unlike earlier revisions of this file, the free models are now
published rather than omitted -- see below.
Free models carry "free": true and no price field, instead of a price of 0. The
scraper does not take that marker on trust: 'expect_zero_units' lists exactly the
units the catalog is expected to state, and the run fails if the catalog prices the
model in any other unit, or at anything other than 0. A model that stops being free
must reach a human rather than keep publishing 'free'.
Last verified against the catalog by a human: 2026-08-04.
When verifying by eye, hard-reload the page first (Ctrl+Shift+R). A cached tab is
what produced a wrong '24 models' reading once already, and a stale browser copy is
indistinguishable from a live one until you compare the results count.
